notes.title: Playtest Update v09
notes.content:
Hello Playtesters!

I need you to take on the first [b]World Boss[/b] to make sure it's fun and beatable! The game is [i]almost[/i] demo-ready in the lead up to the [b]London Games Festival! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792058/0583a886bf0f60186eb8f2ee0004a724bc9cefec.png[/img]
I have also added a cut scene to the game which sets the tone of the adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792058/6eb9075e0ec11bbbadfdebb988cc2a8b891ca43a.png[/img]
[i]This will play automatically the first time you boot up the game, or can be watched when you select the Tutorial from the Map. Players who already have save data will have to watch via the Tutorial.[/i]

[b]Other Updates[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Big Tutorial Update [/b]- the tutorial is now on it's own separate level (no longer 1-1) and is much more concise - breaking down a few elements some players struggled with to improve the learning experience.

[*][b]Endless Mode has been updated.[/b] Fewer Choppas and a smaller playing area makes it easier to focus on the multiple lanes. Leaderboards will be coming soon! 

[*][b]First Summon[/b] added to the game - unlocked after the World Boss.

[*]Thank you message removed, replaced by a one-time message that also plays the game's trailer (will be updated with a more appropriate video once I have one).

[*]Beating 1-5 unlocks an extra trap slot and 3x upgrade options for Traps!

[*]Weather Effects added, will build upon this in further updates.

[*]Bean Beasts cost is displayed differently, hopefully making it clearer to players. 

[*]Many boring bug fixes and minor QOL adjustments made.
[/list]

With the extra trap slot, extra upgrades, smaller map and summon in your inventory it's now possible to get much further on Endless Mode - [b]my new record is 43! [/b]

Cheers!

Anxious Noob.
Josh.

notes.title: Bean Beasts Playtest Update to v08
notes.content:
Hi All - Been working away on fixes and features for Bean Beasts, here are the latest updates!

[b]1) Info Pages[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a placeholder "Info" section to the Main Menu.

[*] Any feedback regarding layout, topics, language and depth of information would be greatly appreciated!
[/list]

[b]2) Trap Upgrades to Try[/b]

[list]
[*] Demon Eye / Ballister. Shoots piercing long range arrows that deal magic damage. 

[*] Mud Blaster / Cannon. Fires balls of mud that can hit more enemies that explode and inflict poison.

[*] Ice Daggers / Spikes. Fast firing ice damage while also inflicting slow.
[/list]

[b]2) Quality of Life Features Added[/b]

[list]
[*] Feedback for Challenge complete/failed made more obvious.

[*] Remixed mini-boss music.

[*] Players can pause during the tutorial.

[*] Change-Direction buttons on upgrade UI now have "cost" clearly labelled.

[*] Change-Direction buttons also transparent when players cannot afford.

[*] V-Sync option is now available for players experiencing screen tearing.

[*] Retry "Last Wave" is now retry "This Wave" - players restart from current wave instead of previous one.

[*] Pause button is displayed when using a gamepad. 
[/list]

[b]3) Graphical Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Hellfire Arrows changes colour on higher levels. 

[*] Frog's "in-water" graphics fixed pixel aspect ratio. 

[*] Ground nodes glow made brighter. 

[*] Range display has been made brighter.
[/list]

[b]4) Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]  WASD key movement getting stuck - fixed.

[*] Improved animation performance.

[*] Enemy weight now affected by shield. 
 
[*] Some players to not be able to pet Tortoise - fixed.

[*] Frog's special range affected by time-speed - fixed.

[*] Some shielded enemies lose their shield sprite prematurely - fixed 

[*] Fixed a bug causing camera/icon movement to be linked to framerate.

[*] Bombs no longer flying off randomly.
[/list]

Cheers!

Josh.

notes.title: Bean Beasts Playtest Update to v07
notes.content:
Once again a huge thank you to those who have donated their precious time to help me improve Bean Beasts! I’ve received a lot of great feedback and have implemented the following updates to the game.

[b]1) Rebalancing[/b]

[list]
[*] Beasts have received a significant power buff: 50% for low level, 150-250% for mid-level and 300%+ for top-tier.

[*] Beast passive XP gain has been adjusted, they now grow much faster while they’re attacking (including ability damage) so players will have to think carefully where they place their Beasts and when to use their specials as this will affect their levels on later waves. 

[*] Trap upgrade costs have been adjusted – the cost-per-DPS ratio has been made steeper. You now have to work a bit harder to unlock the OP top-tier traps and should no longer be able to win most maps with a single well placed trap! 

[*] For Boss Maps and Endless Mode the power escalation of enemies has been toned down and the currency generation per wave has been increased to balance out the trap price adjustments. My record is now Wave 34 after this update so the difficulty should be roughly the same as before. 
[/list]

[b]2) Quality of Life Features Added[/b]

[list]
[*] The range of Towers is now displayed while hovering over a node.

[*] Shortcuts added to exit Upgrade UI panel: Escape / Right Click / Clicking elsewhere in the level.

[*] Pressing Escape now closes all UI panels or goes Back to previous page in the menu.

[*] You can cancel out of building directional towers, by hitting back, escape or the “X” button – there is no cost penalty to changing your mind, energy is returned upon cancelling. 

[*] WASD now controls the camera, along with arrow keys.

[*] Additional Keyboard shortcuts added:
[i](C) Challenge Panel
(F) Fast Forward 
(Z/X) Zoom In/Out
(U) Quick Upgrade (while Upgrade Panel is open) 
(Y) Select Path 1 Upgrade / (I) Select Path 2 Upgrade (while Upgrade Panel is open) 
(1-7) Ability Button Shortcuts[/i]

[*] Info panels added to items in the shop.

[*] Beast XP Boost button now displays current Beast Level.

[*] Adjusted damage number graphics to make them clearer.
[/list]

[b]3) Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Transparent hand icons on shop buttons fixed.

[*] Endless Mode starting energy/beans discrepancy fixed.

[*] Audio levels being too loud and not adjusting on the opening logo screen fixed.

[*] Fixed the bug causing some players to unlock additional Beast Inventory Slot early.

[*] Other minor bug fixes. 
[/list]

[b]4) Graphical Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Some graphic improvements and bug fixes.

[*] "Restart" text added to Win Screen (above Last and First wave buttons)

[*] UI Buttons on book panels made clearer.

[*] Frog spawn challenge text made clearer.
[/list]

Cheers!

Josh.

notes.title: Playtest Update v06 is Ready!
notes.content:
Hi All,

Firstly a huge thank you to the people who have given their time to playtest Bean Beasts!

Thanks to you I've been able to implement many improvements and fix bugs I wouldn't have discovered by myself. I'm now releasing the latest version of the Demo which also includes a new mode to try out. 

PS - Don't forget to Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631450/Bean_Beasts/]Bean Beasts[/url] if you haven't already ːsteamthumbsupː

[b]Exciting Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Endless Map - Compete with other players to reach the highest wave! Unlocked after 1-5.
[*] You can now pet the NPC frog on 1-2 and also the Rider & Mount on every map.
[*] Players have access to 4 trap slots once they unlock Endless Mode.
[*] Huge buff to third stage Bean Beasts (2-3x damage).
[/list]

Feel free to join our Discord to share your high score and see how you measure up against other players! Or discuss feedback you have of the game. 

[url=https://t.co/xBvp7jKc9h]Bean Beasts Discord Group[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792058/2fe0d1eef00008d976e49fae293d5d0830741e7c.png[/img]

[b]Less Exciting Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Labels added to inventory page to make things easier to understand.
[*] XP bar for beasts now shows the correct gained XP from a bean boost.
[*] Ability instructions are now clearer and fade slowly giving players a better chance to notice them.
[*] Inventory Page Now has labels for Beasts, Traps, Mount etc.
[*] Win Page now has a label telling players what they have unlocked.
[*] Cheat Mode has been disabled, for now... Will perhaps make the cheats unlockable in the full game.
[/list]

[b]Boring Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing Rider to not fire at fast enemies.
[*] Close button on upgrade panel now slightly bigger / more noticeable.
[*] Fixed the bug causing bombs to fly off randomly sometimes.
[*] Can now start wave, check challenges and change fast-forward speed with the upgrade panel open.
[*] Some graphical/animation improvements to enemies.
[*] Some timing adjustments in the tutorial.
[*] Made Info/Task panels more obvious on tutorial and added glowing lights to direct player attention.
[*] Some cost balancing for top tier towers and repairing walls
[*] Stunned enemies can no longer attack while stunned.
[*] Optimisation of enemy code when their paths are blocked (the cause of some framerate drops on later levels). 
[/list]

Cheers!

Josh
Anxious Noob

notes.title: Playtest Update to v05
notes.content:
First of all a big thank you to those who have been testing this out for me so far! 

[b]Tutorial Updates[/b]

- Implemented improvements to the tutorial to make it clearer and simpler, including specific button instructions if using a gamepad. 

- Added audio volume and gamepad control icon options to the opening setup page.

- Added an additional information panel to explain the terms "Tower", "Beast" and "Trap"

- Tutorial is now re-playable.

[b]Balancing Update[/b]

- Adjusted the cost of some top tier towers.

- Adjusted the income modifiers on the boss stage.

[b]Graphical Updates[/b]

- Re-adjusted some minor graphical elements: UI panels & text alignment, location of flags on the main map (to include tutorial).

- Moving camera with keyboard is now much smoother.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed the bug where some large enemies get stuck when they reach the end.

- Fixed a bug causing the gamepad icons to disappear when switching between gamepad and mouse.
